title: T06h — Upgrades that raise the schema version
goal: Admit candidates whose reader migrates the schema forward, with an explicit recovery to the operation backup
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; actual profiles, backups, credentials and deployment evidence remain private.
acceptance: A forward migration is admitted only with a reviewed recovery that restores the operation backup and the previous revision on failure
Recovery never runs automatically without the owner; the previous revision is never started on migrated data
validation: Cross-version regressions; independent review; one owner-selected target trial
escalation: Any destructive restore, changed ownership or unresolved physical/worker effects requires explicit reconciliation; general restore remains F-062

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-13 at 0.25x from node tools/work-items.mjs calibrate (median 0.25x over 16 closed steps since 2026-11-12).
